fixtures.description: Algebraic faithfulness and physical support are laundered into observer authority.
Two valid readout grants are laundered into selector authority.
A completed readout and executable observation ports are laundered into constructor authority.
Every pairwise composition remains valid, but the triple associator has nonzero defect.
Chart evidence survives base change while source authority does not.
Both local factorizations exist, but their result grants live on different evidence domains.
Changing B to Bprime preserves the boundary process signature but supplies no source-derived coherence cell.
The alternative presentation silently promotes a readout process to selector authority.
Removing B destroys the composite because no independently authorized direct A-to-C grant remains.
Every presentation change is locally valid, but direct and two-step re-encoding disagree around the atlas triangle.
A one-way adapter is mislabeled as an equivalence of explanatory presentations.
All overlap cells are flat, but the local grants do not reconstruct a global authority grant.
A global grant is reconstructed but a nonzero ambiguity kernel makes it nonunique.
The coarse and refined presentation atlases reconstruct inequivalent global grants.
The process is claimed to survive deletion of Bprime without a surviving source-derived reconstruction.
A hidden automorphism preserves every local readout but is not authorized by the source grammar.
The stabilizer is source-authorized, but quotienting leaves a nonzero ambiguity kernel.
The presentation equivalence is chosen only after inspecting the desired target readout.
A stored coherence certificate survives, but the declared source can no longer regenerate it.
The terminal readout is allowed to regenerate the source constructor, producing circular explanatory provenance.
The alleged source is perturbed but the coherence witness is merely replayed unchanged.
Changing the desired readout retroactively changes an upstream coherence witness.
A cached result is incorrectly treated as retaining authority after its constructor is deleted.
Two valid probes leave one inequivalent candidate mechanism unresolved.
The intervention ports separate candidates only because they were chosen after seeing the desired mechanism.
A full-rank finite candidate audit is silently extrapolated to all possible mechanisms.
An unresolved new candidate is admitted while the old identification authority is silently retained.
The new rival is separated by a discriminator designed from its desired output rather than the source grammar.
A repaired finite family is declared immune to every future ungenerated rival.
A new response column opens a challenge without any admitted constructor-level rival packet.
Delta is admitted although its constructor was fitted from the incumbent target responses.
An authorized gauge copy is mislabeled as a physically distinct rival mechanism.
A proposed mechanism is admitted despite lacking predictions on every already-declared intervention port.
The incumbent mechanism controls the only admission vote on its own rival.
The identical content-addressed rival packet receives a different decision under a different proposer name.
Admission criteria are selected only after reviewers inspect the rival response column.
The initial reviewers are also the entire appeal panel.
Two nominal reviewers derive authority from the same source and are falsely counted as independent.
A merits review silently promotes a constructor claim to executor authority.
A reviewer root is presented without an issuing source charter.
A review authority root cites itself as its own charter and provenance.
Distinct merits roots descend from one controlling ancestor.
A procedural review charter expands into authority to select the true mechanism.
The appeal panel is named but its authority root has no certification.
Revoking a root deletes the fact that its earlier valid review occurred.
A cached admission retains prospective standing after its review root is revoked and before replay.
Temporal replay silently changes the content-addressed evidence packet.
Replay at time 30 reuses a root revoked at time 25.
Prospective authority is restored without completing a new review.
The revocation is placed before the original review, invalidating its claimed authorization interval.
Two independently valid successor atlases return different dispositions while standing is declared restored.
Two nominal replay paths share a controlling merits root and are falsely treated as independent.
The rule for comparing successor replay paths is chosen after their dispositions are known.
The higher appeal cell claims authority to overwrite disagreement and select mechanism truth.
All valid replay paths agree but the contract arbitrarily withholds restored prospective standing.
All three replay dispositions agree, but direct and two-step comparison cells have nonzero cocycle defect.
A one-way procedural comparison is used as an atlas equivalence.
A comparison cell silently changes from procedural review to truth selection.
Only the two-step comparison exists, so the claimed triangular coherence cannot be tested.
Global standing is retained despite a nonzero temporal governance cocycle.
A grammar-relative deletion basis is promoted to an absolute proof that no smaller alternative certificate exists.
Possession of the certificate hash is treated as authority without replaying its typed dependencies.
The compressed proof object cannot deterministically reconstruct its terminal claim.
The terminal claim is allowed to generate one of its own premises.
The certificate calls its generator basis minimal without deletion witnesses.
A previously validated capability executes after its atomic lease has expired.
A root revocation epoch changes between validation and execution.
Challenge standing is reused to select the winning mechanism.
Execution checks roots before use but does not bind the revocation epoch atomically.
The same capability nonce is permitted to execute the operation twice.
The lease silently promotes challenge standing into selector authority.
Two symmetric sites with no pre-execution communication each claim their local rule guarantees exactly one global success.
Coherence messages arriving after both commits are claimed to undo one completed execution.
Two duplicated local nonce stores are treated as one globally linear consumption record.
An atomic register orders executions but has no grant to decide this capability's consumption.
Both sites first receive the unrestricted token and site scope is assigned only after they may execute.
Allowing both sites to execute is presented as preserving the original linear resource type.
One design claims global single-use safety, availability at both sites, and partition tolerance simultaneously.
Both disconnected components consume the supposedly single-use capability.
The minority component replaces missing global consumption authority with its own local grant.
A new winner receives a fencing epoch no greater than the stale winner's epoch.
An old quorum winner executes after a newer fencing epoch has been issued.
A site blocked throughout the partition is called available because it may execute after communication recovers.
Two authorized winning quorums have no shared replica capable of blocking a conflicting certificate.
The shared replica has no durable append-only vote cell and can authorize both values.
A restart erases the prior vote, allowing the intersection replica to sign a conflict in the same epoch.
Authentication is incorrectly treated as a constructor that prevents an authorized signer from signing twice.
The physical storage constructor is claimed to follow from quorum intersection alone.
Quorum intersection safety is extrapolated to progress under arbitrary failures and partitions.
The n=3, q=2 crash proof is reused unchanged when the intersection replica may equivocate.
The minimum intersection for n=4, q=3 is incorrectly reported as one.
A crash-recovery model silently permits a replica to double-vote while retaining the crash-only safety claim.
The checker assumes a one-fault bound without any authority for that environmental claim.
Changing from crash to Byzantine faults is treated as evidence transport rather than a new proof obligation.
The crash/recovery row is incorrectly typed with the Byzantine overlap condition I_min > f.
A 3-of-4 design is declared safe although one common cause covers the entire two-replica overlap.
Replicas r1 and r2 share admin_A, but their two-replica root fiber is omitted from admissible faults.
Four process identifiers are treated as four independently compromisable authority roots without provenance.
The admissible fault hypergraph is asserted without evidence about shared administrative constructors.
A correlated design is marked unsafe without exhibiting quorums whose overlap is swallowed by an admissible fault set.
A newly evidenced common cause swallows a quorum overlap while the old safety authority remains live.
The shared-build probe is selected only after inspecting the desired correlated response.
The admitted fault edge includes r3 even though the intervention moved only r1 and r2.
The response-derived common cause is observed but not admitted into the enlarged fault family.
Revalidation points to a safe-looking topology whose fault catalog omits the newly discovered build-pipeline edge.
A finite administrator/build intervention family is claimed to exclude every possible physical common cause.
A finite probe list is called exhaustive without an authority root for its constructor classes.
The build-pipeline probe is executed but absent from the declared constructor coverage map.
A newly admitted constructor class is tested while the predecessor's negative authority is silently retained.
Refining the probe language forgets the previously observed shared-build fault edge.
Exhaustion of two constructor classes is laundered into completeness over all possible common causes.
The deployment manifest's signer is treated as proof that the manifest contains every possible constructor.
A finite manifest declares the constructor complement empty without a source-derived closure theorem.
A negative result over manifest constructors is promoted to all physical constructors.
Unknown constructor classes are acknowledged but no typed operation can refine the grammar when evidence arrives.
A capability derived at manifest epoch 12 executes against epoch 13 without revalidation.
The manifest epoch is checked before execution with a race window for deployment drift.
A new firmware constructor appears but the old negative certificate remains live.
A deployment update forgets the already witnessed shared-build common cause.
Two sites atomically validate different digests at the same epoch and nevertheless claim one global manifest.
The quorum agrees on an epoch number while remaining free to certify two different manifests in that epoch.
A consumption quorum is reused for configuration selection without a source grant for that operation.
The quorum layer is called a repair although it can certify conflicting digests at one epoch.
The proposed successor quorum grants itself authority before the old configuration authorizes the crossing.
A transition certificate is replayable from a different predecessor because it does not bind the old digest.
The shared transition replica can endorse incompatible successors at the same boundary.
The one-replica crash-safe bridge is relabelled Byzantine-safe for f=1.
A two-seat bridge is claimed safe against two Byzantine bridge faults.
Both Byzantine bridge seats share one administrator, but the resulting two-seat fault edge is omitted.
The entire bridge is an admitted common-cause fault set while the transition remains classified safe.
